autoConnectEnabled.label: Auto-connect discovered SHIP devices
autoConnectEnabled.help: Opens a field-test SHIP WebSocket session to discovered devices where possible.

shipServerEnabled.label: Enable local TLS/WebSocket SHIP endpoint
shipServerEnabled.help: Starts a local /ship/ endpoint so wallboxes and other devices can pair with NexoWatt EOS.

announceShipService.label: Announce local SHIP service via mDNS
announceShipService.help: Required when wallboxes or other EEBUS devices should discover EOS as local HEMS automatically via _ship._tcp. In EnergyManagementSystem mode this is enforced by the adapter.

shipHandshakeEnabled.label: Enable SHIP handshake state machine
shipHandshakeEnabled.help: Enables CMI, Hello, protocol handshake and PIN-state handling for field tests.

spineDiscoveryEnabled.label: Request SPINE NodeManagement discovery
spineDiscoveryEnabled.help: After SHIP data exchange is ready, the adapter sends a read-only NodeManagement detailed discovery request. This is not blocked by command dry run.

serviceName.label: Pairing name visible on the device
serviceName.help: This is the name shown by wallboxes, heat pumps and other EEBUS devices during HEMS pairing. Keep the default NexoWatt EOS unless multiple EOS systems share one network.

model.label: Model
model.help: Fixed EEBUS product model: EOS. Legacy values such as EEBUS Adapter are migrated automatically.

deviceType.label: Device type
deviceType.help: Fixed protocol-facing device type: EnergyManagementSystem. This identifies NexoWatt EOS as the local HEMS.

deviceCategories.label: SHIP device categories
deviceCategories.help: Fixed EEBUS installation category 2 = Energy Management System (EMS).

ianaPen.label: IANA PEN for NexoWatt
ianaPen.help: The value 999999 is only a field-test placeholder. Enter the officially assigned NexoWatt IANA PEN before a new production SHIP identity is generated. Changing this field does not replace an already generated SHIP ID.

shipId.label: Generated SHIP ID
shipId.help: Stable identifier of this EOS SHIP node. Do not delete or replace it after pairing devices.

localSki.label: Generated local SKI
localSki.help: Stable Subject Key Identifier derived from the local TLS certificate. This is the key shown or entered during EEBUS pairing.

certificateFingerprint.label: Certificate fingerprint SHA-256
certificateFingerprint.help: SHA-256 fingerprint of the local TLS certificate for diagnostics and verification.

certificate.label: Certificate PEM
certificate.help: Leave empty to generate a local certificate on first start.

privateKey.label: Private key PEM
privateKey.help: Protected/encrypted. Leave empty to generate a local private key on first start.

autoAcceptNewDevices.label: Auto accept new devices for field testing
autoAcceptNewDevices.help: Only for controlled lab tests. New SHIP peers are trusted automatically and Hello continues immediately.

nexowattBridgeEnabled.label: Enable direct §14a API to NexoWatt EOS
nexowattBridgeEnabled.help: Forwards EEBUS LPC commands directly to the EOS controller without manual data-point mapping.

nexowattUiInstance.label: NexoWatt UI instance
nexowattUiInstance.help: Use auto for automatic instance detection. A fixed value such as nexowatt-ui.0 is only needed for multiple EOS instances.

autoApplyClsLimits.label: Apply CLS power limits automatically
autoApplyClsLimits.help: When enabled, accepted LPC limits immediately trigger a full EOS control cycle.

sendImplementationResultToCls.label: Send effective EOS controller readback to the CLS box
sendImplementationResultToCls.help: The final correlated write result is always sent after the full EOS control cycle. This option additionally sends the effective LoadControl readback when the cycle succeeds.

nexowattBridgeRequestTimeoutMs.label: Maximum API acceptance wait
nexowattBridgeRequestTimeoutMs.help: The regulation command is rejected when EOS does not accept it within this interval.

clsHeartbeatTimeoutSec.label: Fallback CLS heartbeat timeout
clsHeartbeatTimeoutSec.help: Used only when the CLS peer does not provide a heartbeat timeout. LPC heartbeats are supervised independently of diagnostic polling.

allowCommandsToUntrustedDevices.label: Allow commands to untrusted devices
allowCommandsToUntrustedDevices.help: Default is off. Commands to untrusted or unknown devices are recorded but not sent.

commandDryRun.label: Command dry run
commandDryRun.help: Records field-test SPINE command payloads without sending them. Disable only after pairing/data exchange was verified.

debugRawMessages.label: Store raw diagnostic messages
debugRawMessages.help: May create large states. Enable only for troubleshooting.
